name: World
lead: A room's blocks, entities, displays, screens and time: the `world` global, or `room.world`.

functions.name: on_generate
functions.signature: world.on_generate(fn: (chunk: Chunk) -> ())
functions.description: Called for a chunk each time it comes into memory, in a script world; it must make the same blocks every time.

functions.name: on_populate
functions.signature: world.on_populate(fn: (chunk: Chunk) -> ())
functions.description: Each chunk the overworld terrain made, once, after it made it.

functions.name: dimension
functions.signature: world.dimension(name: string) → World
functions.description: Another world of the server's group, by dimension id or its last part ("dungeon", "minecraft:the_nether"): that world's own `world` table.

functions.name: drop
functions.signature: world.drop(pos: Vec3, item: ItemSpec)
functions.description: A stack on the ground at a block, as a broken block leaves one.

functions.name: container
functions.signature: world.container(pos: Vec3) → Container ?
functions.description: A chest's stacks, or nil where the block keeps none.

functions.name: rules
functions.signature: world.rules(opts: { survival: boolean ?, fall: boolean ?, damage: boolean ?, hunger: boolean ?, anticheat: boolean ?, day_cycle: boolean ?, redstone: boolean ? }?) → Rules
functions.description: `world.rules{ fall = true }` switches one on, false off; a rule left out or nil keeps its value, and a number or a string is an error. `world.rules()` reads them.

functions.name: raycast
functions.signature: world.raycast(from: Vec3, direction: Vec3, max: number ?) → RayHit ?
functions.description: The first block a ray from `from` along `direction` meets within `max` blocks, and the face it came in through; nil for none.

functions.name: sees
functions.signature: world.sees(from: Vec3, to: Vec3) → boolean
functions.description: True when no block stops the line from `from` to `to`: a block with a collision box does (glass, leaves), water and grass do not.

functions.name: raycasts
functions.signature: world.raycasts(rays: buffer, out: buffer, n: number)
functions.description: `n` lines at once. `rays` holds six f64 a line (from x, y, z, to x, y, z); `out` gets one f64 a line: how far along it the first block is that stops it, or -1 for a clear line.

functions.name: light_at
functions.signature: world.light_at(pos: Vec3) → (number, number, boolean)
functions.description: Block light and sky light, 0 to 15, and whether nothing above holds off the sky.

functions.name: path
functions.signature: world.path(from: Vec3, to: Vec3, opts: { size: (number | { number })?, swim: boolean ?, fall: number ?, range: number ?, budget: number ? }?) → { Vec3 }?
functions.description: The points a body walks from `from` to the block at `to`, or nil. The game's own search: a step up of one block, falls of `fall` (3). `size` is { width, height } (0.6, 1.8); `swim` goes through water; `range` (the distance + 16) and `budget` (2000 nodes) stop a long search, which then gives the part that came closest.

functions.name: zone
functions.signature: world.zone(opts: { from: Vec3, to: Vec3, on_enter: ((player: Player) -> ())?, on_leave: ((player: Player) -> ())? }) → Zone
functions.description: Makes a box of blocks, both corners included, that knows who is in it; checked once a tick by feet position. Ends with the script.

functions.name: set_block
functions.signature: world.set_block(pos: Vec3, block: BlockRef, opts: { skin: HeadSkin ? }?)
functions.description: `skin` is for "player_head" and "player_wall_head" only: an account's name, or the raw `textures` property.

functions.name: set_blocks
functions.signature: world.set_blocks(changes: { { at: Vec3, block: BlockRef, skin: HeadSkin ? } })
functions.description: Sets many blocks at once, live, stored and sent; the cheapest way. A row takes `skin` too, for a player head.

functions.name: fill
functions.signature: world.fill(from: Vec3, to: Vec3, block: BlockRef)
functions.description: Fills a box of blocks between two corners, live, stored and sent to everyone.

functions.name: schematic
functions.signature: world.schematic(file: string) → Schematic
functions.description: A file inside the pack; a path that leaves it, or one that is not there, is an error naming the file.

functions.name: build
functions.signature: world.build(fn: (b: Builder) -> (), opts: { detail: number ? }?) → Schematic
functions.description: The same value, written in code instead of read from a file. `{ detail = 2 }`: coordinates are half blocks, fitted to slabs and stairs.

functions.name: paste
functions.signature: world.paste(schem: Schematic, origin: Vec3, opts: { air: boolean ?, part: string ? }?)
functions.description: Live, stored and sent; air is skipped unless `air` is true.

functions.name: get_block
functions.signature: world.get_block(pos: Vec3) → string ?
functions.description: `nil` where that chunk is not in memory: a read never generates.

functions.name: block
functions.signature: world.block(pos: Vec3) → BlockAt ?
functions.description: The block there as the handle a hook gets: reads are live, and what it does lands on the next tick. `state` and `data` are for this pack's own blocks. `nil` where that chunk is not in memory.

functions.name: get_biome
functions.signature: world.get_biome(pos: Vec3) → string ?
functions.description: Returns the biome name of the column at `pos`; `nil` where that chunk is not in memory.

functions.name: generate
functions.signature: world.generate(rules: GeneratorRules) → Generated
functions.description: Declares this world: the engine makes each chunk from the rules, on every core, and no script runs for a chunk.

functions.name: get_blocks
functions.signature: world.get_blocks(from: Vec3, to: Vec3) → { string ? }
functions.description: A box, in x, then z, then y order.

functions.name: items
functions.signature: world.items() → { GroundItem }
functions.description: The stacks on the ground: `{ id, item, count, at }` rows.

functions.name: spawn
functions.signature: world.spawn(def: EntityDef | string, pos: Vec3, data: { [string]: any }?) → EntityHandle ?
functions.description: Puts an entity at a point and returns its handle. A mob kind of the game by name (`world.spawn("cow", pos)`) is the game's own entity, and takes no `data`. A pack's own kind takes the data it starts life holding. `nil` for a kind nothing defined and this game does not have.

functions.name: entities
functions.signature: world.entities(query: { near: Vec3 ?, radius: number ?, kind: string ?, mob: boolean ? }?) → { EntityHandle }
functions.description: Live and queued entities, in ascending id. Optional near/radius select a sphere; kind filters by canonical name. near and radius go together. `mob = true` gives the mobs only, `mob = false` the rest.

functions.name: explode
functions.signature: world.explode(pos: Vec3, power: number ?)
functions.description: A blast at a point. The power is clamped by this game's own column and the tick's explosion budget decides when it goes off, never whether.

functions.name: on_block_break
functions.signature: world.on_block_break(fn: (player: Player ?, pos: Vec3, block: string) -> ()) → Connection
functions.description: What the survival tick did. Observe-only: the world has already changed, and what the callback returns is not read.

functions.name: on_block_place
functions.signature: world.on_block_place(fn: (player: Player ?, pos: Vec3, block: string) -> ()) → Connection
functions.description: Tells after a block was placed, with its canonical name. Observe-only; `player` is nil when nobody placed it or they left.

functions.name: on_entity_spawn
functions.signature: world.on_entity_spawn(fn: (entity: EntityHandle, name: string) -> ()) → Connection
functions.description: Tells after a mob appeared, with its handle and name; a natural spawn fires it on every game version that has one, and a pack's own `world.spawn("cow", pos)` fires it too. Mob kinds only.

functions.name: on_entity_death
functions.signature: world.on_entity_death(fn: (id: number, name: string) -> ()) → Connection
functions.description: Tells after a mob died; it is gone, so its id and name is all there is. Mob kinds only.

functions.name: time
functions.signature: world.time((at: number | TimeName | (s: number) -> number | TimeName) -> ()) → & (() -> number)
functions.description: Holds the sky at a time (ticks, or "sunrise", "day", "noon", "sunset", "night", "midnight"), or asks a function each tick, `s` seconds after the call. With no argument: the time of day now, 0 to 23999.

functions.name: light
functions.signature: world.light(sources: { LightSource })
functions.description: Sends players light no block makes, 1 to 15 a source; each call replaces the last, `{}` ends it. 1.14 and later.

functions.name: screen
functions.signature: world.screen(opts: { at: Vec3, facing: Facing | "up", up: Facing ?, width: number ?, height: number ?, glow: boolean ?, on_click: ((player: Player, x: number, y: number, button: "left" | "right") -> ())?, }) → Screen
functions.description: Puts a wall of map frames, `width` by `height` frames (128 pixels each), in front of a wall; `at` is the top-left frame. Returns a Screen.

functions.name: canvas
functions.signature: world.canvas(opts: { width: number ?, height: number ? }?) → Canvas
functions.description: Makes a picture of `width` by `height` maps (1 by 1 by default, 16 at most a side) with no frame of its own, for a frame, a hand or a screen.

functions.name: display
functions.signature: world.display((opts: { kind: "model", model: Model, at: Vec3 ?, rotation: Orientation ?, scale: (number | Vec3)?, -- models require equal positive axes paint: { [string]: Ink }?, fallback: string ?, seats: { Vec3 }?, lead: boolean ?, }) -> ModelDisplay) → & ((opts: { kind: "item" | "text" | "block" | "frame", at: Vec3 ?, rotation: Orientation ?, scale: (Vec3 | number)?, billboard: Billboard ?, glow: (Ink | false)?, item: ItemSpec ?, canvas: Canvas ?, context: Context ?, text: Text ?, color: Ink ?, background: (Ink | false)?, line_width: number ?, shadow: boolean ?, block: string ?, facing: ScreenFacing ?, invisible: boolean ?, glide: number ?, lead: boolean ?, }) -> Display)
functions.description: A model stands in the world through the same call as everything else, and is the one kind that hands back something other than a Display.

functions.name: hitbox
functions.signature: world.hitbox(opts: { at: Vec3, width: number ?, height: number ?, depth: number ?, solid: boolean ?, on_click: ((player: Player, button: "left" | "right") -> ())?, }) → Hitbox
functions.description: Makes an invisible box a player can click; `solid` also makes it a wall. `depth` is the width unless given. 1.19.4 and later.

functions.name: npc
functions.signature: world.npc(opts: { name: string ?, at: Vec3 ?, rotation: BodyRotation ?, skin: (string | { value: string, signature: string } | false)?, }) → Npc
functions.description: Places a player-shaped entity every client from 1.8 sees; removed when the script ends or reloads.

functions.name: puppet
functions.signature: world.puppet(opts: { kind: string, at: Vec3 ?, rotation: BodyRotation ?, name: Text ? }) → Puppet
functions.description: Places a mob's body with no mind of its own that the script moves; its name tag always shows. An error when this game has no such mob kind.

fields.name: spawn_point
fields.description: Where players arrive in this room; writable. The same value as the room's `spawn_point`.

title: world global · type World
